headline: Shares of AI cloud firms CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN fell after the research firm Gartner forecast that more than 80% of 'neocloud' companies will stop operating independently by 2030.
score_reason: Facts match the headline; the forecast is Gartner's and the fall also reflects CoreWeave's bond worries.
importance_line: Investors and lenders in AI computing firms are most exposed; the doubt is that this is a forecast, and CoreWeave's slide had other triggers the same day.
summary: Stocktwits, in a report on TradingView, says shares of CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN fell on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026 after Gartner forecast that over 80% of neoclouds, which rent out specialised AI chips and computing power, will shut down or merge by 2030. Will Sommer, a senior director analyst at Gartner, said money earned from AI will not be enough to pay back all the planned AI spending at a profit.
notes: Same Gartner report as C07-18 (read there in the release text); this entry is the market-reaction angle and also the main text source for C07-02. Stocktwits retail-sentiment details left out.
